people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”
translations.bsb: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua. Then Joshua asked them, “Who are you and where have you come from?”
translations.kjv: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come
translations.asv: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
